protocol.seat_rotation: same deal for each focal seat and both focal policies
protocol.opponents: all remaining seats are copies of the named opponent
protocol.engine: BatchedPesten, canonical game.Game first finisher, 1000 turn cap
protocol.random: randomAgent.AgentRandom semantics; shared MT19937 hand/deck stream and seeded Python suit RNG
protocol.statistic: wins / all games; equal weights for six cells, draws count as zero wins
protocol.intervals: two-sided individual 95% normal intervals for paired win-rate differences; one independent sample per deal block, disjoint deal banks across cells
